blockers.description: The hosted behavior verifier collapses every 30-second fetch abort into the same generic TimeoutError and writes no evidence until full completion; the exact failing operation is therefore unknown.
blockers.workaround: Before another hosted run, add credential-safe step labels and elapsed timings to httpJson/call sites, add contract tests, and prove that logs contain no secret or user content.

blockers.description: Supabase Auth Admin DELETE intermittently returns HTTP 504 and observed HTTP 200 log entries have not been sufficient evidence of durable deletion.
blockers.workaround: After every attempt, independently GET each exact manifest user and audit all seven relations. Use the already owner-approved guarded SQL cleanup only for the exact prevalidated fixture identities, with exact count and storage-zero gates.

blockers.description: Typed child executors did not inherit the owner's production-mutation approval through their prompt context.
blockers.workaround: Let child agents perform read-only preflight only; run any exact approved hosted mutation from the root context.

decisions.decision: Do not rerun the unchanged hosted behavior verifier.
decisions.rationale: It repeatedly recreates fixtures, times out without identifying the failing step, and forces cleanup without producing useful evidence.

decisions.decision: Keep the guarded SQL cleanup as an exact-fixture fallback only.
decisions.rationale: It is authorized only after manifest identity validation, exact row-count checks, and proof that neither disposable user owns storage objects.

decisions.decision: Treat independent 404 and seven-relation zero checks as the cleanup authority.
decisions.rationale: Auth logs and DELETE response codes were not reliable evidence of durable absence.
Plans 04-04 and 04-05 require a completed, zero-residue hosted behavior proof from Plan 04-03.
